textPreview: In charged cosmic rays, the AMS-02 antiproton data show a tentative excess at kinetic energies around 10--20 GeV that could be fit by an 80 GeV dark matter particle annihilating into $b\bar{b}$ --- parameters that overlap suggestively with those of the Galactic Center excess \cite{Cirelli:2024ssz}.

textPreview: However, once the substantial systematic uncertainties in the cosmic-ray propagation models and antiproton production cross-sections are accounted for, the significance of this excess drops below $2\sigma$, and the data remain consistent with a purely secondary astrophysical origin \cite{Cirelli:2024ssz}.
